title: Cursor pagination for an API

requirements.text: The next-page cursor is opaque and encodes the last sort keys, not an offset
Walking every page returns each item exactly once, using a unique tie-breaker for repeated sort values
Cursors are integrity-protected and expire; tampered, expired or malformed cursors are rejected with a distinguishable error
The page size is validated and clamped to a server maximum
Responses signal whether more pages exist (null next cursor or a rel=next link) so clients stop correctly
The database query seeks by the cursor keys on an index (keyset), not OFFSET scanning
A cursor cannot be replayed against a different tenant, filter or sort to read data outside the original query
